title: Review airline foreign ownership limits; screen investors through CFIUS
uncertainties: Searches performed: two web searches (airline foreign ownership limits with the Transportation Secretary; a 119th Congress bill on airline foreign ownership), which returned only older material such as the 2019 GAO report and a 115th Congress bill, and in review a Federal Register API query for foreign ownership together with air carrier since 2025-01-20, which returned only a drone proposal, an FCC spectrum rule and the Unified Agenda introduction. BILLSTATUS was not scanned, and DOT citizenship determinations for individual carriers are not published in the Federal Register, so a bill or carrier-specific order could exist without being surfaced. The GAO report is pre-period background only. Checked systematically on 2026-10-18: Federal Register API searches (DOT and all agencies), the DOT proposed-rule listing as fallback because the Unified Agenda listing was unreachable, one congress.gov and govinfo search with BILLSTATUS reads and the 49 U.S.C. 40102 notes (cut off partway), the DOT press release listing and one news search found no action on airline foreign ownership limits or a CFIUS-based framework. DOT carrier-specific citizenship orders are not in the Federal Register and the DOT policy page could not be fetched.
